title: Noniv/abyssal-garden
why_read: An impressive piece of procedural graphics programming packed into a tiny single HTML file using WebGPU.
analysis: This project renders an entire underwater scene, including kelp, light shafts, a sunken ship, and manta rays, purely through code using WebGPU with no external images, 3D models, or audio assets, all fitting in a 97 KB file. That's a notable feat of procedural generation and shader programming, which is technically impressive and a good showcase of what WebGPU can do in the browser. It's more of a creative coding demo than a production tool, but it's a genuinely interesting technical artifact for graphics-minded engineers.
